**Finding: LD — Compliant (preferred position).**

No Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalties, early-termination fee, or minimum/accelerated fees exist anywhere in the Agreement:

- **§ 11 Fees (p0084)** — Sparkling's sole payment obligation is the Fee Schedule fees; no interest, acceleration or minimum commitment.
- **§ 17(b) (p0118)** — Sparkling has an at-will 90-day termination right with only cease-use and certification obligations, and no termination charge.
- **§ 17(c) / p0128** — Termination for Garman's default runs in our favour: perpetual licence with no further fees plus refund of prepaid amounts.
- **§ 8 (p0057)** — Rejection of the Software requires Garman to return all amounts paid.
- **§ 15 (p0105)** — Limits recovery to direct damages; it does not pre-fix any Customer payment. The only "penalties" reference (p0090) is inside Garman's indemnity to us.
- Charges under § 10(c) (p0077) are rate-card repair fees for Sparkling-caused faults, i.e. service pricing, not liquidated damages.

Because the preferred element ("Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties") is satisfied by the absence of any such mechanic, no redline was proposed.
